<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<title>Results</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:light dark;--bg:#fff;--ink:#10131a;--ink2:#5a6372;--rule:#e5e8ec;--soft:#f6f7f9;--accent:#2545c8;--amber:#8f5508;--amberbg:#fdf3e1;--red:#c0392b}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0d0f13;--ink:#e8eaee;--ink2:#8a93a0;--rule:#23272e;--soft:#14171c;--accent:#6a8cff;--amber:#e8b03e;--amberbg:#2a2113;--red:#ff8478}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
main{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 56px}
h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.lead{color:var(--ink2);margin:0 0 16px;max-width:64ch}
.home{display:inline-block;margin:0 0 16px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){.home{color:#0d0f13}}
.banner{background:var(--amberbg);border-left:4px solid var(--amber);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 24px;font-size:14px}
h2{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 12px}section{margin-bottom:34px}
a{color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:2px}.home:hover{text-decoration:underline}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.tile{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px}.tile .k{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}.tile .v{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}.tile .c{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
.card{background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--accent)}.card.one{border-left-color:var(--amber)}
.card h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 4px}.what{margin:4px 0 8px}.do{margin:0 0 8px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0}.chip{font-size:12px;line-height:1;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink2)}.chip.one{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber)}
.meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)}
ul.u{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}ul.u li{padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}.who{display:block;color:var(--ink2);font-size:13.5px}
.links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.need{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px}.empty,.foot{color:var(--ink2);font-size:13px}.err{color:var(--red)}
@media (max-width:640px){main{padding:18px 14px 40px}h1{font-size:21px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>
<script id="maskin-sources" type="application/json">{
 "ws": {
  "type": "knowledge",
  "group_by": "status"
 },
 "new": {
  "type": "knowledge",
  "filters": {
   "created_after": "now-7d"
  }
 },
 "idle": {
  "type": "knowledge",
  "filters": {
   "status": "draft",
   "updated_before": "now-14d"
  }
 },
 "stale": {
  "type": "knowledge",
  "filters": {
   "status": "validated",
   "updated_before": "now-60d"
  }
 }
}</script></head><body><main id="root"></main>
<script id="results-data" type="application/json">{
 "headline": "Is our business context complete, fresh and readable?",
 "lead": "This is the layer agents and people read before they decide. The counters below are live. The findings fill in when the Knowledge Curator does its first Monday refresh. Targets: Idle drafts and Stale pages, each aiming at zero.",
 "tiles": [
  {
   "k": "Validated pages",
   "src": "ws",
   "group": "validated",
   "c": "Live, whole workspace"
  },
  {
   "k": "Draft pages",
   "src": "ws",
   "group": "draft",
   "c": "All drafts, live"
  },
  {
   "k": "Idle drafts",
   "src": "idle",
   "c": "Target 0. Drafts not edited in 14 days"
  },
  {
   "k": "Stale pages",
   "src": "stale",
   "c": "Target 0. Validated, not edited in 60 days"
  },
  {
   "k": "New pages in 7 days",
   "src": "new",
   "c": "Output, not the goal"
  }
 ],
 "cardsTitle": "What we found",
 "cards": [],
 "unknownsTitle": "Still unknown, and who finds out",
 "unknowns": [],
 "foot": "Refreshed by the Knowledge Curator every Monday. Counters are live."
}</script>
<script>(function(){
var D;function el(t,c,x){var e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e}
function link(t,u){var a=el('a',null,t);a.href=u;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';return a}
function render(){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='';
 r.appendChild(el('h1',null,D.headline));r.appendChild(el('p','lead',D.lead));
 if(D.home){var h=link(D.home.t,D.home.u);h.className='home';r.appendChild(h)}
 if(D.banner)r.appendChild(el('p','banner',D.banner));
 if(D.tiles&&D.tiles.length){var s=el('section');var g=el('div','tiles');D.tiles.forEach(function(t){var d=el('div','tile');d.appendChild(el('div','k',t.k));var v=el('div','v','...');d.appendChild(v);var c=el('div','c',t.c||'');d.appendChild(c);g.appendChild(d);
  maskin.query(t.src).then(function(q){var n=q.total.count;if(t.group){var f=q.groups.filter(function(x){return x.key===t.group})[0];n=f?f.count:0}v.textContent=String(n)}).catch(function(e){v.textContent='n/a';v.className='v err';c.textContent=e&&e.message?e.message:''})});s.appendChild(g);r.appendChild(s)}
 var s2=el('section');s2.appendChild(el('h2',null,D.cardsTitle));
 if(!D.cards.length)s2.appendChild(el('p','empty','Nothing to show yet. The Knowledge Curator fills this in on its first Monday refresh.'));
 D.cards.forEach(function(f){var c=el('article','card'+(f.one?' one':''));var h=el('h3');if(f.u){h.appendChild(link(f.title,f.u))}else{h.textContent=f.title}c.appendChild(h);
  var ch=el('div','chips');if(f.conf)ch.appendChild(el('span','chip',f.conf+' confidence'));if(f.one)ch.appendChild(el('span','chip one','One voice only'));c.appendChild(ch);
  if(f.what)c.appendChild(el('p','what',f.what));if(f.do){var p=el('p','do');p.appendChild(el('b',null,'What to do: '));p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(f.do));c.appendChild(p)}
  var m=el('p','meta');if(f.owner)m.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Owner: '+f.owner+'. '));(f.sources||[]).slice(0,2).forEach(function(s,i){if(i)m.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));m.appendChild(link(s.t,s.u))});c.appendChild(m);s2.appendChild(c)});
 r.appendChild(s2);
 if(D.unknowns&&D.unknowns.length){var s3=el('section');s3.appendChild(el('h2',null,D.unknownsTitle));var ul=el('ul','u');D.unknowns.slice(0,3).forEach(function(u){var li=el('li');li.appendChild(el('span',null,u.q));li.appendChild(el('span','who',u.who));ul.appendChild(li)});s3.appendChild(ul);r.appendChild(s3)}
 if(D.links&&D.links.length){var s5=el('section');s5.appendChild(el('h2',null,'Go deeper in the wiki'));var l=el('ul','links');D.links.forEach(function(k){var li=el('li');li.appendChild(link(k.t,k.u));l.appendChild(li)});s5.appendChild(l);r.appendChild(s5)}
 if(D.needs){var s4=el('section');s4.appendChild(el('h2',null,'Needs a person now'));s4.appendChild(el('div','need',D.needs));r.appendChild(s4)}
 r.appendChild(el('p','foot',D.foot||''))}
try{D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('results-data').textContent);render()}catch(e){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='The page could not load. Try again.';r.className='err'}
})();</script></body></html>
